message:
fix(server): supply optional JWT lifetime argument in PKI and SSH dispatch

The native authorized dispatcher now accepts a request-local JWT lifetime output. Its PKI and SSH owner callers still passed thirteen arguments, causing two E0061 errors in the normal release build. Pass None from these two non-JWT calls while preserving their existing arguments and all JWT login lifetime handling.

The original failed build and compiler logs are retained. The corrected candidate still requires the unchanged release-build and 149-test / 166-invocation runtime gates.
